slides.title: You lean back to finish it.
slides.body: Ribs flared, lower back arched, bar overhead. It looks locked out. It isn't.

slides.title: The arch steals your lockout.
slides.body: Lean back and the bar ends up in front of you. Your shoulders hold it out there instead of stacking under it.

slides.title: Ribs down before the bar moves.
slides.body: Squeeze your glutes, brace, pull your ribs down. Then press. Not the other way round.

slides.title: Head through the window.
slides.body: Bar over the middle of your foot, ears just in front of your arms. Wrists, shoulders and hips in one line.

slides.title: Can't lock out without arching?
slides.body: Then it's too heavy for a strict press today. Drop the load until the line stays stacked.
